description: The values the other tools take, read from the data: every role slug with its name, every Spanish region code with its name and the experience buckets (0-1, 2-4, 5-7...) that have salaries, with the date the salaries were last refreshed and the minimum number of people a figure needs. It takes no arguments and returns no salaries. Call it once, before salary_stats, top_companies, company_salaries or find_jobs, when unsure how a role or region is named or which exist; skip it when you already have a slug or code, since those tools also take common names such as Madrid or Data Scientist.
